target='....((....((....((....((..((..((...))..))....))......)).......)).........)).............'
n=len(target)
seq=['A']*n
# alternate orientation to break cross-bulge spurious helices
# stem1 G-C, stem2 C-G, stem3 G-C, stem4 C-G, stem5 G-C, stem6 C-G
stems=[(4,74,'GC'),(10,63,'CG'),(16,54,'GC'),(22,46,'CG'),(26,40,'GC'),(30,36,'CG')]

        seq[i]='G'; seq[j]='C'
        seq[i+1]='G'; seq[j-1]='C'
    else:
        seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'
        seq[i+1]='C'; seq[j-1]='G'
s=''.join(seq)
print(len(s), s)
"
